title: Trader paper book has no paper worker; it must run trader intents only

problem_register_ref.section: RC4. Nobody looks at the whole design
problem_register_ref.row: Agora: the trading servant does not serve the human trader (SD-AGORA-SERVANT-CORE-CAPABILITIES-20261127 T7/T8 follow-up)

root_cause.desired_state_exclusion: services/control-plane/bff/personas/trader_paper_book.py::ensure_trader_paper_book coordinated Registry/Governance/Deployment authorities when configured but deployed the RuntimeBinding to Runtime-Manager without attaching the approved artifact execution projection (object_store, artifact_checksum, symbol, market_data_policy) produced by StagePlanner.build_execution_projection. As a result, services/runtime-manager/fleet_desired_state.py::_execution_projection_exclusion_reason excluded rb-77d962be4e324032808324109f2c154e with exclusion_reason='non_executable_missing_artifact_store' and paper-fleet-reconciler spawned no paper_runtime.py worker for rt-persona-paper-3ca8da543bef6ede0a07.
root_cause.strategy_signal_isolation: Once a trader servant paper book RuntimeBinding carries the approved artifact execution projection so desired-state admits it and paper-fleet-reconciler runs its worker subprocess, paper-signal-producer must not evaluate the bootstrap close_to_close_momentum StrategyArtifact on that binding; a trader servant paper book executes only trader-confirmed paper intents enqueued by the T8 consumer (source_worker == 'paper-signal-producer.agora-intent').

changes.summary: Added PersonaProvisioningCoordinator.build_paper_execution_projection_metadata(record, ids, deployment_plan_receipt=..., registry_receipt=...) reusing StagePlanner().build_execution_projection(plan_obj, entry), validate_strategy_artifact, strategy_artifact_checksum, and strategy_artifact_minimum_closes (the exact projection path used by DeploymentService.create_plan). Requires real validated Registry and DeploymentPlan owner receipts via self._validate_registry(..., state='approved') and DeploymentPlan.from_dict(deployment_plan_receipt).validate(), failing closed on absent, incomplete, or unapproved receipts with zero synthesized approvals or defaulted authority fields.

Updated ensure_trader_paper_book to resolve the approved artifact projection from real Registry and Deployment owner receipts (failing closed with reason_code='deploy_authorities_unavailable' when Registry/Governance/Deployment owners are unconfigured or when receipts are absent/unapproved), attach the StagePlanner.build_execution_projection metadata on new RuntimeBinding creation, and repair existing active bindings lacking the projection (such as hosted rb-77d962be4e324032808324109f2c154e) in place on the same binding_id via RuntimeManagerClient.transition without creating a second pool, capital binding, or RuntimeBinding. Preserved the P-4 paper risk policy gate in _transport_supports_paper_risk_gate independently of drafter/proposer availability whenever Capital and Governance owners are configured (accepting an existing valid approved capital_pool_activation mapping without a drafter, and otherwise failing closed before any RuntimeBinding deploy or transition when drafting or approval cannot resolve). Kept read_trader_paper_book (GET /bff/agora/servant/paper-book) strictly read-only with zero Runtime-Manager transitions or owner writes, and preserved deliberately paused bindings (failing closed with reason_code='runtime_binding_not_active' and zero transitions).

Added TRADER_SERVANT_PAPER_BOOK_KIND = 'trader_servant_paper_book' and _is_trader_servant_paper_book_binding(binding), gating PaperSignalProducer.settle_pending_intraday, PaperSignalProducer.produce, and PaperSignalProducer._produce_current so paper-signal-producer neither settles/releases pre-existing parked strategy decisions nor generates current strategy decisions or signals for trader servant paper book bindings while leaving the three trading personas' pending_settlement and settle_pending_intraday next-open release untouched.
Unchanged (zero exemption list added); trader servant paper book bindings pass _execution_projection_exclusion_reason via the standard StagePlanner.build_execution_projection metadata.

Wired owner_stack with real authority receipts for Registry/Governance/Deployment and added test_provisioned_trader_paper_book_is_listed_in_runtime_fleet_desired_state_bindings (AC1), test_existing_hosted_trader_paper_book_without_execution_projection_is_repaired_in_place_on_same_binding_id (AC2), test_get_and_read_trader_paper_book_are_strictly_read_only_on_legacy_active_binding (P1 regression), test_get_and_ensure_preserve_deliberately_paused_legacy_binding_with_zero_transitions (P1 regression), and test_missing_owner_missing_receipt_and_draft_receipt_fail_closed_with_zero_deploy_or_repair_transitions (P1 / AC1 regression).

Wired servant_paper_world with Registry and Deployment authority endpoints backed by real Governance approval decisions so ensure_trader_paper_book resolves real approved authority receipts, and added test_p4_risk_policy_gate_enforced_without_drafter_and_replays_existing_approved_mapping proving configured-owner P-4 validation independently of drafter/proposer availability (new-book and in-place-repair fail closed with zero deploy/transition calls on unresolved mapping; existing approved mapping replays and repairs in place without a drafter).

Added TestTraderServantPaperBookIntentOnlyAndPersonaSettlement covering AC3 (zero strategy decisions and zero strategy signals on an executable trader book binding, plus test_preseeded_parked_strategy_decision_is_not_settled_or_released_for_trader_servant_paper_book proving a preseeded pending_settlement strategy record is neither settled nor released on D+1 open once metadata.book_kind == 'trader_servant_paper_book', while preserving T8 paper-signal-producer.agora-intent signals) and AC4 (the three trading personas' pending_settlement parking and settle_pending_intraday D+1 open release unchanged).

Recorded PAPER-TRADER-BOOK-EXECUTABLE-INTENT-ONLY-20261127 (owner Antigravity, cross-family reviewer Codex) in the RC4 Agora servant row and attached the two AC5 storage residuals (unbounded public.telemetry_heartbeat_hourly_summaries retention and uncompacted closed instrument_positions / execution_prices / settled_futures_contracts in the per-binding performance ledger JSON) to RC3 WP3.1.

paper_worker_subprocess_memory.measurement_method: Spawned PaperFleetReconciler parent process plus 4 real PaperRuntimeService subprocesses (rt-49c1c3d1 + 3 trading personas qinghe, hengyue, chengchuan) and then added the 5th subprocess for rb-77d962be4e324032808324109f2c154e (rt-persona-paper-3ca8da543bef6ede0a07), reading VmHWM (peak RSS) and VmRSS from /proc/<pid>/status after draining heartbeat/fill cycles and persisting ledger + outbox state.
paper_worker_subprocess_memory.measurement_command: .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -c '<spawn PaperFleetReconciler + 4 baseline PaperRuntimeService worker subprocesses + 5th trader paper book worker subprocess rb-77d962be4e324032808324109f2c154e; read /proc/<pid>/status VmHWM/VmRSS and stat ledger/outbox files>'
paper_worker_subprocess_memory.comparison_with_hosted_cgroup_limit: Measured 4-worker + reconciler process VmHWM sum is 267.86 MiB (hosted cgroup baseline in docs/deployment/evidence/DEV-COMPOSE-MEMORY-LIMITS-PEAK-SIZED-20261117/evidence.json:14 is 253 MiB anon + 382 MiB page cache = 640 MiB cgroup peak). Adding the 5th worker adds 53.78 MiB VmHWM (321.64 MiB total process VmHWM; ~694 MiB projected cgroup peak including the 382 MiB page cache), leaving ~586 MiB headroom below the 1280 MiB container memory cap (DEV_MEM_LIMIT_PAPER_FLEET_RECONCILER:-1280m in docker-compose.yml:2981).
paper_worker_subprocess_memory.cleanup: PaperFleetReconciler._terminate_worker (services/paper_fleet_reconciler/paper_fleet_reconciler.py:1218-1277) terminates the worker subprocess on binding pause, retirement, or desired-state exclusion (SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL after RECONCILER_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=10s).

per_binding_performance_ledger_file.write_cadence: Atomic in-place snapshot rewrite via atomic_write_text (single deterministic <path>.tmp sibling; sweep_stale_temp_siblings on startup) on fill commit, mark valuation update, futures expiry settlement, or performance pair stage/ack (0 writes/day when idle with no trader intents).
per_binding_performance_ledger_file.size_growth_and_cap_analysis: PaperExecutionAlgorithm._persist_state (paper_runtime.py:6506-6575) rewrites the per-binding ledger file in place via atomic_write_text. While holdings (6528-6532) and open_episodes (6533-6545) filter to currently non-zero positions (abs(quantity) > 1e-12), pending_performance_pair (6526) holds at most 1 dict cleared on ack_performance_pair (6781-6795), pending_fill_publications (6527) is drained to [] on ack_fill_publication (6697-6714), and _ledger_fill_history (4681-4682, 6165-6166) is a 256-entry RAM-only ring buffer not written to disk, the ledger JSON has NO coded cardinality cap or post-close eviction for three persisted collections: (1) execution_prices (6546-6550, restored into self.Securities at 6483-6487) retains every symbol/instrument ever priced with a finite positive price; (2) instrument_positions (6551-6557) retains every (persona_binding_id, normalised_underlying, instrument_id) record ever traded because closing an equity/futures position (6119-6122, 4647-4650, 4850) or settling an expiring futures contract (4998-5006) sets quantity=0.0 and status='closed' without deleting the entry; and (3) settled_futures_contracts (6565, added at 5014 and restored at 6481) retains every settled f'{b_id}:{inst_id}:{month}' contract key. Measured ledger size is 674 B idle, 1,312-1,331 B with 1 open 2330.TW position, and 1,254 B after closing 2330.TW (holdings=0, execution_prices=1, instrument_positions=1 with status='closed'). Re-trading and closing an already-traded instrument updates its existing entry in place (1,255 B, ~0 B net growth), whereas each newly traded distinct equity instrument adds 531.22 B (measured 6,035 B across 10 closed distinct symbols) and each settled futures contract month adds 60.33 B (measured 6,216 B with 3 settled futures contract keys). For the trader servant paper book (0 strategy signals/day; T8 daily cap of 50 paper intents/day per SD_AGORA_SERVANT_CORE_2026-11-27.md §8.3), daily ledger growth is 0 B/day when idle or trading already-seen instruments, ~0-2.7 KB/day for typical trader usage (0-5 new distinct instruments/day), and <= 26.6 KB/day worst case if all 50 daily intents traded brand-new distinct instruments never traded before on the book (bounded only by the finite universe of ~2,000-2,600 listed Taiwan equities -> ~1.06-1.38 MB plus ~60 B per settled futures contract month, with no hardcoded entry cap in paper_runtime.py). The sibling LifecycleTelemetryOutbox (.lifecycle-outbox.json) IS time-window bounded by _prune_expired_chains (paper_runtime.py:7322-7348), which prunes any journey with no pending events whose last correlation_envelope.event_time is older than _chain_retention_seconds() (default _LIFECYCLE_CHAIN_RETENTION_DEFAULT_SECONDS = 35 days at paper_runtime.py:130; measured 110 B idle, 26,953 B across 35 retained journey checkpoints = ~767 B/chain, capped at <= ~1.34 MB steady state under the T8 cap of 50 intents/day x 35 days = <=1,750 chains).
per_binding_performance_ledger_file.cleanup: No in-life compaction or eviction of closed instrument_positions, execution_prices, or settled_futures_contracts entries exists in paper_runtime.py (documented in residual_findings below and attached to RC3 WP3.1). Whole-file deletion occurs on binding retirement when PaperFleetReconciler._cleanup_retired_state_files (services/paper_fleet_reconciler/paper_fleet_reconciler.py:1299-1425) unlinks the per-binding ledger file, .lifecycle-outbox.json, .member-books.json, .lock, and any .tmp siblings once the binding is retired in Runtime-Manager, not in desired-state, has no live worker, and its pending fill publications, pending performance pair, and outbox pending list are empty.
